status: verified after approximation, interpolation, and local-filter repairs

blocks.title: Real and complex arithmetic
work: Complex division under extreme scaling: 2 failing cases.
Real Tanh, Ctanh, and Asinh: 12 cases including the original regressions.
Complex Actan/Acosh branches and a negative real base with a complex exponent: 12 cases.
Quadratic equations with a zero linear coefficient and real cube roots in the cubic solver: 5 cases.
blocks.validation: Check principal branches, scaling invariance, finite limiting values, polynomial residuals, and Vieta identities; retain all passing elementary-function and special-function checks.

blocks.title: Exact integer arithmetic and number theory
work: First fix termination of IsPrime(1) for both integer widths (2 cases); keep the process timeouts enabled.
Then repair primality/factorization and the dependent radical/totient calculations.
Normalize GCD/Bezout signs; remove premature overflow and float arithmetic from LCM and modular powers.
Repair coprime search, digit order, integer base conversion, and zero/exponent-zero handling.
blocks.validation: Use BigInteger references, factor-product and primality checks, Bezout identities, and both integer widths. The 89 parameterized IntegerOperations cases cover several operations, not 89 separate defects.

blocks.title: Matrix indexing, complex statistics, and distances
work: Rectangular indexing and placement: diagonal multiplication 8, Shift 4, Merge 6, mesh evaluation 8, Swap 12; total 38 cases.
Hermitian variance, covariance, and norms: 5 cases including the two original regressions.
Sokal-Sneath denominator: 3 independent contingency-table checks.
blocks.validation: Use non-square arrays in both orientations, all real/complex overloads, independent index maps, and conjugate inner products. Verify covariance symmetry and nonnegative norms.
blocks.caveat: Hermitian sample statistics; Swap axis meanings and diagonal pseudoinverse zero convention retained. Resize interpolation remains in B05.

blocks.title: Probability distributions
work: PowerNormal and PowerLognormal: 29 reference failures; align the documented law, PDF, and CDF.
Binomial and Poisson: 9 failures across boundaries, mass, entropy, modes, and medians.
Birnbaum-Saunders: 10 failures across median, mode, and entropy.
Other moments/entropy: 16; FoldedNormal mode and ChiSquare median checks: 3.
blocks.validation: Use independent PDF integrals, CDF/PDF differentiation, normalization, parameter-dependent existence of moments, and both median inequalities. Recheck each distribution after shared scalar fixes.
blocks.caveat: Power laws follow the NIST survival-power definition. Discrete medians use the lower median; ChiSquare uses CDF inversion. Unsupported getters remain explicit.

blocks.title: Approximation, interpolation, and local array filters
work: Pade denominator degree greater than numerator degree: 2 cases.
Bilinear grid-edge interpolation: 2 cases.
Bicubic resizing at scale one: 3 cases (real array, complex array, bitmap).
Local mean: 2; morphology ranks: 4; exact half-turn rotation: 2.
blocks.validation: Compare Taylor coefficients, exact affine interpolation, impulse responses, sorted edge neighborhoods, and pixel/sample identities. Check endpoints and rectangular shapes.
blocks.caveat: Mean windows use clipped normalization and retain separable weighted passes. Bicubic resizing aligns sample centers. General-angle sampling and Padé conditioning are not exhaustive guarantees.

blocks.title: Matrix decompositions
work: Handle Schur zero-matrix deflation and termination first: 3 cases.
Separate SVD reconstruction from pseudoinverse singular-value thresholding: 9 cases.
Repair GEVD eigenvector accumulation/normalization: 3 cases.
blocks.validation: Check reconstruction, orthogonality/unitarity, all four Penrose equations, generalized eigen-equations, and bounded termination on zero/rank-deficient inputs.
blocks.caveat: The exact internal cause of the rank-one SVD reconstruction failure is not fully localized. Fixing reciprocal zero singular values alone is insufficient to declare the SVD block complete.

blocks.title: Wavelets
work: Bior/CDF reconstruction banks: 54 cases including 2 original Bior13 regressions.
Meyer removable singularities: 3 cases.
blocks.validation: Check synthesis/analysis coefficient pairing, normalization, phase/alignment, impulses, deterministic signals, and analytical limits. Retain the distinction between reconstruction banks and prototype wavelets that do not promise perfect reconstruction.

blocks.title: Window functions
work: Independent window formulas: 11 cases, including the Bartlett-Hann sign and Gaussian centering.
Explicit frame size versus stored frame size: 5 cases.
Original even Normal/Confined symmetry regressions: 2 cases.
blocks.validation: Check odd/even lengths, endpoint values, symmetry, independent sample formulas, and independence from stored size when an explicit size is supplied.

blocks.title: Transforms and response filters
work: Hankel positive-zero bracketing and normalization: 4 cases.
Laplacian pyramid/vector filter reconstruction and constant preservation: 8 cases.
BilateralGrid and LocalLaplacian constant/phase behavior: 4 cases.
Complex threshold overload consistency: 2 cases.
IIR characteristic polynomial/stability: 3 cases; ConeShape sign for negative tau: 2 cases.
blocks.validation: Check ordered positive Bessel zeros, independent transform matrices, reconstruction, DC/phase preservation, threshold equality, and poles of the actual difference equation.
blocks.caveat: BilateralGrid complex semantics, LocalLaplacian approximation/DC bias, and component-versus-magnitude thresholding need explicit API decisions. These are six failing expectations, not six already-localized algebraic mistakes. The order-5 Hankel search currently converges toward the origin.

blocks.title: Color spaces
work: XYZ/LAB white point, range, and round trips: 15 cases including the original XYZ regression.
RYB chroma/white preservation: 4 cases; AHSL chroma: 2 cases.
blocks.validation: Use D65 reference coordinates, primary/neutral colors, gamut boundaries, and round trips with the existing quantization budgets. Repair XYZ before judging downstream LAB differences.

blocks.title: Images, geometry, and rendering
work: Lookup-table normalization and pixel equations: 8 cases.
Padded/negative bitmap stride: 8; histogram median: 3; tensor alpha/channel reconstruction: 4.
Constant-image ColorTransfer: 2; depth histogram counter overflow: 2.
Figure rendering of constant series: 15; rectangle area overflow: 1; depth Merge coordinates: 1.
blocks.validation: Use guarded buffers for stride/padding, exact neutral pixels, independent histogram ranks, opaque alpha for RGB inputs, zero-variance limits, wide area/count arithmetic, and finite rendering ranges.
blocks.caveat: The bicubic bitmap resize failure belongs to B05 and is not counted here. ColorTransfer should be rechecked after matrix statistics and color-space repairs.

blocks.title: Video stream parsing
work: MIME boundary parameters/case handling: 2 cases.
MJPEG headers split across one-, two-, and three-byte transport chunks: 3 cases.
blocks.validation: Use in-memory streams with arbitrary split points, bounded buffer indices, quoted/trailing parameters, and case variants. No live camera or network is needed.
blocks.caveat: This is a parsing/contract block, not a numerical mathematics defect.
